description.value:
You had one simple job: getting your associates as far away from danger as quickly as possible. Whether you were part of a security force protecting a VIP or a member of heist waiting for the rest of your crew to return, you know how to quickly and safely put as much distance between yourself and an active crime scene as possible, even if that means having to abandon one vehicle and pick up another along the way.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Vehicle Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Quick Starter] skill feat.
